description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 02.11.2020 to 08.11.2020
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the establishment of new exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs exercising powers vested by law. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements for financial transactions related to customs, rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
